issues.description: model_answer direct load of exported PEFT fails: Hyper/peft _get_submodules returns 4 values but caller unpacks 3 (peft/tuners/lora.py:333 vs utils/other.py:168); also merge_and_unload drops the vision tower. Both are Hyper peft defects, not V6 code.
issues.impact: The literal llava.eval.model_answer entry cannot load V6 exports; the sanctioned repo eval entry (compose.eval.eval_task, compose and peft modes) reads all snapshot artifacts and was used for the dry run.
issues.workaround: Use eval_task (compose/peft) or model_answer_routed. Fix Hyper peft separately if literal model_answer is required.

issues.description: Task-1 snapshot persists the state machine at RMS_READY (created before the SNAPSHOT_READY advance). Resume analysis still maps the correct node.
issues.workaround: None needed; documented in the E12 report.

issues.description: Single-GPU batch-1 training (accum 24) is slow (~30-40 min per 2000-sample task). Gradient checkpointing conflicts with frozen-backbone + ComposeSelection (no-grad in backward); SDPA attention patch hangs on this stack.
issues.workaround: Official run: 4 GPUs with per-device batch 6, accum 1, eager attention (verified batch 6 on 1 card OOMs, but 4 cards halve per-card load); or keep batch-1 single-card.
